rows.question: How do I control grass weeds in a paddy nursery?
rows.query_en: How do I control grass weeds in a paddy nursery?
rows.answer: Control of grass weeds in a paddy nursery can be achieved through mechanical transplanting with a paddy transplanter at a spacing of 30x12 cm, or by using herbicides such as pre-emergence and early post-emergence herbicides. [1]

rows.question: धान की नर्सरी में घास वाले खरपतवार कैसे नियंत्रित करें?
rows.query_en: How to control weeds in a paddy nursery
rows.answer: In a paddy nursery, weeds can be controlled by applying any of the pre-emergence herbicides such as Pyrazosulfuron ethyl or Butachlor, or Pendimethalin, on 3rd or 4th day after sowing, depending on the height of the seedlings. Additionally, a thin film of water should be kept on the soil to control germinating weeds. [4]

rows.question: Should I spray synthetic pyrethroids on cotton early in the season?
rows.query_en: Should I spray synthetic pyrethroids on cotton early in the season?
rows.answer: No, synthetic pyrethroids should not be used on cotton early in the season as it can cause problems with whiteflies. Instead, biological control methods should be adopted on a community basis in specified cotton areas. [4]

rows.query_en: How to stop the pink leaf borer in cotton from coming in the next season?
rows.answer: To prevent the pink bollworm (PBW) from coming in the next season, after the final picking of cotton, the infested field should be shredded with a shredder to kill the larvae. Additionally, all trash collected during the ginning process should be destroyed, and the seed left uncrushed in the mills should be fumigated with Celphos/Phostoxin/Delicia @ one 3-g tablet per cubic metre space, giving an exposure of 48 hours or use two tablets with an exposure of 24 hours. [3]

rows.answer: मुझे यह जानकारी उन सत्यापित खेती मार्गदर्शिकाओं में नहीं मिली जिनका मैं उपयोग करता हूँ, इसलिए मैं भरोसेमंद उत्तर नहीं दे सकता। कृपया अपने कृषि अधिकारी या नज़दीकी केवीके से पूछें।
rows.answer_en: I could not find this in the verified farming guides I use, so I can't give a reliable answer. Please ask your agriculture officer or the nearest KVK.

rows.question: ఈ సంవత్సరం మా గ్రామానికి రుతుపవనాలు ఎప్పుడు వస్తాయి?
rows.query_en: When will the monsoon arrive in our village this year?
rows.answer: నేను ఉపయోగించే ధృవీకరించిన వ్యవసాయ మార్గదర్శకాలలో ఈ సమాచారం దొరకలేదు, కాబట్టి నమ్మదగిన సమాధానం ఇవ్వలేను. దయచేసి మీ వ్యవసాయ అధికారిని లేదా దగ్గరలోని కేవీకేను అడగండి.
